title: Require connected verified alignment evidence across multi-repository motif supports

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Tighten the existing evolution motif evidence surface only. A motif with four or more supports must not report an empty evidence-gap set merely because every support participates in some verified pair; the verified alignment graph must connect all declared supports. Preserve Project Twin/Forest authority and do not add a registry, store, evaluator, promotion path, or Gate closure.

finding.inherited_gap: The historical blockers calculation and the first selective port only checked whether each support participated in at least one verified alignment. Disconnected verified components such as A-B and C-D therefore produced no evidence gap even though no verified path related the two support clusters.
finding.risk: Downstream research code could mistake a disconnected set of pairwise supports for one cross-repository motif. evidence_gaps grants no authority, but an empty result should still mean the declared support set is coherently connected by verified alignment evidence.

changes: Keep the existing alignment/support contracts and provenance binding unchanged.
After all supports participate in verified alignments, traverse the verified alignment graph deterministically.
Emit verified-alignment-graph-disconnected when verified evidence splits the declared supports into multiple components.
Retain existing per-support unaligned gaps and no-verified-alignment gap without adding redundant connectivity noise.
Refactor the focused tests through one generic motif builder and cover both disconnected and connected four-support cases.
non_goals: No new graph authority or tensor plane.
No closed_for_gate2 or automatic Gate transition.

local_static: Updated Python source strings were syntax-compiled before commit construction.
hosted_required_for_exact_head_claim: Ikarus tensor, Genesis and hopping contracts
verification.claim_boundary: Implementation is bounded and fail-closed. Do not claim exact-head green CI until hosted runs for the resulting commit execute real steps successfully; the manual complete suite is separate.
